notes.title: He Comes Every Night
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45666041/b3aa58bbc4fd3b22da08d8c462f22ca60e4838b2.png"][/img]Welcome to [b]Pine Hollow Trailer Park[/b] — a forgotten place with six trailers, strange neighbors, and something that arrives after dark.[/p][p]During the day, everything feels normal: fix the wiring, take out the trash, talk to folks. But at night, the park changes. Lights flicker. Sirens scream. Something knocks at your door.
And each morning… one less neighbor shows up.[/p][p][b]No One Here But Me[/b] is a short, immersive psychological horror experience with a nostalgic PSX/VHS aesthetic.[/p][p]You moved in yesterday.
Tonight, something’s coming.
And by the seventh night… no one may be left.[/p]
